name: Shop the Look – Carousel
description: Swipeable lookbook carousel with lifestyle images, product hotspots, and multi-product cards per look. Each look features a large editorial image with positioned hotspot dots and a product card that cycles through linked products with dot navigation. Product images swap on hover to show a second variant. Supports prev/next arrows, touch swipe, autoplay, and full color/layout customization.
author: Section Hub
features: Swipeable look carousel with prev/next arrows
Multiple products per look with dot navigation
Hotspot dots on lifestyle image linked to products
Product image hover swap (shows second image)
Wishlist heart icon on product card
Responsive design with stacked mobile layout
